senses.definition: The grand end of something, especially of a show or piece of music.

quotes.text: Andre Santos equalised and the outstanding Theo Walcott put Arsenal ahead for the first time before Juan Mata's spectacular strike set up the finale for an enthralling encounter.
quotes.reference: 2011 October 29, Phil McNulty, “Chelsea 3 - 5 Arsenal”, in BBC Sport:

senses.definition: (narratology) The chronological conclusion of a series of narrative works.
